title: Tech Note: Generating QR Codes in 4D (Revised on Aug 4th, 2023)
author: Nhat Do, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Still fully valid: generating QR codes via an embedded web area and a JS library remains a standard, still-current 4D technique; only the specific third-party JS library choice might change over time.
related_updates: The web-area + PROCESS 4D TAGS + WA EXECUTE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION pattern is unchanged in modern 4D and continues to be the recommended way to bridge 4D code and client-side JavaScript/HTML.
No native/built-in QR-generation command has since been added to 4D, so this JS-library-based technique remains necessary and current.
